name: dsh-token-usage
description: DSH token 用量查看器：输入框读数、侧栏卡片、侧栏图标打开的主面板报表（按天热图 + 按模型/会话分组占比 + 相对基准），支持删除会话（连同 token 记录和会话文件）。Token usage readout for DeepSeek Harness: composer reading, sidebar card, and a main-column usage report with a daily heatmap, grouped share tables and relative baselines, plus session deletion.

scripts.test: node scripts/check.mjs && node test/verify.mjs && node test/host.mjs
